query.text:
declare @ContractCode varchar(33) select @ContractCode = _2so_hd from dmhd a where ma_hd = @ma_hd and exists(select 1 from dmhd where ma_hd = a._2so_hd and loai_hd2 = '3' and ma_hd_me = @ma_hd)
select ma_dot, da_xuat_hd, da_tt0, da_tt1, ngay_tt, tttt_cdt0, tttt_cdt1, ngay_tttt_cdt, tong_da_tt, no_kho_doi, von_tu_co, von_giai_ngan into #x from zhopdongtt a where ma_hd = @ContractCode
select @@fieldExternal from @@table a left join #x x on a.ma_dot = x.ma_dot where @@whereClause order by @@orderByClause
